name: Bursa Malaysia Berhad
overview: 2026年，Bursa Malaysia 与 Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing Limited (HKEX) 签署谅解备忘录，探讨双重上市、Shariah-compliant 证券、ETF 产品、联合指数及碳市场等合作；同时公司宣布派发中期及末期股息。最新一季（2026-09-30）营收同比增长25.5%，净利润同比增长23.0%。
overview_en: In 2026, Bursa Malaysia entered into a Memorandum of Understanding with Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing Limited (HKEX) to explore cooperation in dual listings, Shariah-compliant securities, ETF products, joint indices and carbon markets; the company also declared interim and final dividends. For the latest quarter ended 30 September 2026, revenue rose 25.5% year-on-year and net profit rose 23.0% year-on-year.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 与 Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing Limited (HKEX) 签署谅解备忘录，探讨双重上市、Shariah-compliant 证券、ETF 产品、联合开发指数及碳市场等合作。
actions.text_en: Entered into a Memorandum of Understanding with Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing Limited (HKEX) to explore cooperation in areas including dual listings, Shariah-compliant securities, ETF products, joint development of indices and carbon markets.
